excerpt.zh: 古老并且部分被翻译的记录已经在[From.Planet.GetName]上被挖掘的废墟中发现。[Root.GetLeaderName]报告说这份记录包含着一些能对我们科学家有益处的技术细节。
excerpt.en: Ancient, partially translated records have been discovered amongst the ruins being excavated on [From.Planet.GetName]. [Root.GetLeaderName] reports that the records contain several technical specifications that may be of value to our scientists.
